alloy_blade.description: A blade pressed from alloy plating. Holds an edge far better than scrap.

alloy_chestplate.description: Alloy plating shaped to a pilot's chest. Solid.

alloy_gauntlets.description: Alloy gauntlets. Heavy, but my hands are worth it.

alloy_greaves.description: Alloy leg plates. They clank with every step.

alloy_helmet.description: An alloy helmet. It dents so my head doesn't.

alloy_pistol.description: An alloy-framed pistol that fires gas cartridges. Steadier than a pipe.

alloy_plating.description: Thick plating stripped from old hulls. Armor, weapons and walkers all start here.

breacher_plate.description: A breacher's armor, cut down to fit a pilot. Very heavy, and very worth it.

canister.description: A metal canister. Holds gas, ichor or coolant, and a faint smell of all three.

coolant.description: Cold, blue, and very good at keeping machines from cooking.

deadeye_injector.description: Steadies the aim for a while. A firearms boost in a needle.

edge_injector.description: A rush of fighting focus in a needle. Hits land harder for a while.

empty_injector.description: Empty. The bio-still can fill it again.

gas_cartridge.description: Compressed vent gas, ready to be fired out of a pistol.

glowroot.description: A root that glows with the ichor it drank. Splicers love it.

healing_injector.description: Patches a pilot up in a hurry. A small hurry.

ichor.description: Warm, glowing and faintly sticky. Splicers brew with it; nobody's sure what it is.

pipe_pistol.description: A length of pipe that fires gas cartridges. It mostly points the right way.

relic_blade.description: A blade in the old fleet pattern. It still hums faintly.

relic_chestplate.description: A chestplate in the old fleet pattern, wired with relic circuitry.

relic_circuitry.description: Circuit boards from the fleet's day. Nobody makes these any more; we just take them.

relic_gauntlets.description: Gauntlets in the old fleet pattern. They fit like they were printed for me.

relic_greaves.description: Greaves in the old fleet pattern. Light, and quieter than scrap.

relic_helmet.description: A helmet in the old fleet pattern. Its visor still flickers on.

relic_pistol.description: A fleet-pattern sidearm. Better than a pipe, and it knows it.

rustcap.description: A mushroom that eats rust. Tastes like a bolt, I imagine.

scrap_blade.description: Sharpened scrap with a grip. It'll do.

scrap_chestplate.description: Scrap bolted into a chestplate. Better than nothing, just.

scrap_greaves.description: Scrap strapped round my legs. Officially armor.

scrap_helmet.description: A helmet made from a bucket. Probably a bucket.

scrap_metal.description: Twisted metal from the yard. Where everything starts.

seep_moss.description: Moss from an ichor seep. Damp, always.

servo_actuator.description: A heavy servo from a breacher's joint. Walkers need strong knees.

servo_blade.description: A blade on a servo arm, which swings it harder than I can.

servo_grease.description: Thick grease for servo joints. It gets everywhere.

servo_pistol.description: A pistol with a servo-driven action. Fast, heavy and loud.

surge_injector.description: A big dose of repair gel, for when a healing injector won't cut it.

vent_gas.description: Pressurised gas from a vent. Ammo, fuel, and a bad smell.

vent_salt.description: Salt crusted round a ventbloom's roots. Splicers use it to set a brew.

ventbloom.description: A flower grown on vent gas. It smells like the vent, too.

bent_bolt.description: Bent past saving. The metal press can still use it.

dead_battery.description: Flat. It rattles when you shake it.

burnt_chip.description: A circuit board that smells of smoke. Some of the traces are still good.

frayed_wire.description: A tangle of copper. Good for nothing but the press.

cracked_lens.description: A sensor lens with a crack right across it.

tin_pilot.description: A little tin figure of a pilot in an old flight suit. Human, by the look of it.

rubber_duck.description: Somebody carried this a very long way.

lucky_cog.description: Polished smooth by a thumb that isn't yours.

snow_globe.description: A tiny city under glass. Nobody here has seen a city.

cracked_photo.description: A crew of five in front of a gantry, grinning. One of them is a loader.

music_chip.description: Plays the first four notes of a song, then stops.

lore_shard_1.description: A data shard with a yard tally etched on the case: forty-one hulls, then the scratches stop.
lore_shard_1.lore: LOG 1, yard tally, shift foreman's copy. Hull 2207 down the wall rails at dawn, stripped by noon. Hull 2208 overdue. Hull 2209 overdue. Told the loaders to keep the bays clear for them anyway. They're good about that. They'll keep them clear forever if nobody tells them otherwise.

lore_shard_2.description: A data shard someone has written "MINE" on in grease pencil. Not anymore.
lore_shard_2.lore: LOG 2, personal. Got printed again today. Third time this month. The tech says the pattern's fine, it's just me being careless. Funny thing: I remember the fall, and I remember waking up, and there's a gap between them the exact shape of a person. Going to stop counting.

lore_shard_3.description: A data shard with a relay stamp. Most of the header has been read so many times it's worn away.
lore_shard_3.lore: LOG 3, relay traffic, inbound. Message body: HOLD. Sender field corrupted. Timestamp corrupted. Repeat count: 1. Every unit on the yard acknowledged within the second. Nobody here thought to ask what we were holding, or for how long.

lore_shard_4.description: A data shard, warm to the touch. It was kept close to something that ran hot.
lore_shard_4.lore: LOG 4, foundry handover. Last walker frame is off the line. Blueprint sealed in the vault. Warden instructed to release it to a returning crew and nobody else. It will want some proof you're crew. In my experience it accepts being knocked flat on its back as proof.

lore_shard_5.description: A data shard spattered pink. The pink does not come off.
lore_shard_5.lore: LOG 5, maintenance ticket, never closed. The paint press in hall C is still running its colour test. The test calls for a target. There is no target. It has decided that anything standing still is close enough. Recommend nobody stands still.

lore_shard_6.description: A data shard with a crack straight through it, like it was stepped on by something heavy.
lore_shard_6.lore: LOG 6, perimeter watch, Deadfields. Seismic again tonight. Not a quake; it has a rhythm. Left, right. Sent a sentry pair out to look. One came back. It won't stop facing east. Requesting the walker programme be moved up, and a lot more ammunition.

traffic_cone.description: It fits your head perfectly. Suspiciously perfectly.

antenna_hat.description: Picks up nothing, but looks like it should.

crown_of_bolts.description: Bolted together by someone with time on their hands.

flame_decal.description: Makes you faster. It does not make you faster.

hazard_paint.description: Yellow and black stripes. Stand back.

chrome_paint.description: You can see yourself in it. You look great.

scuttle_drone_pet.description: A tiny drone that has decided you are its home.

loader_pup_pet.description: A loader barely bigger than a crate. It wants to carry things for you.

mini_press_pet.description: A pocket Splatterpress. It only paints the floor.

sentry_eye.description: A relic sentry's eye, still in one piece. It's still looking at you.

loader_horn.description: The warning horn off a loader mech. HONK.

warden_core.description: The Undercroft warden's heart, humming quietly.

press_core.description: The Splatterpress's control core, still dripping.

colossus_heart.description: Warm, heavy, and much bigger than a heart should be.

mech_blueprint.description: Rolled plans for a two-seat walker, stamped with the foundry's seal. The foreman will want this.

coolant_bloom.description: A ventbloom grown in coolant instead of ichor. It glows a cold blue and is very slightly cold to the touch.

paint_reservoir.description: The Splatterpress's paint tank. It sloshes. Every colour at once.

pilot_wings.description: Given to the crew that first powered up the mech.

survey_drone_pet.description: Pell's little survey drone. It has opinions about everything you find.

glowcap_specimen.description: A glowing cap from the fungal cavern, sealed in a sample jar.

skyfern_specimen.description: A fern that only grows where it can see the sky.

ruin_orchid_specimen.description: An orchid growing out of a crack in a wall older than the yard.

paintball_cannon.description: Does no damage at all. Splats paint on whatever it hits, players included. Nobody minds. Much.

paint_pellets.description: Every colour, one at a time.

confetti_blade.description: A party in a sword. Hits for nothing, every time, and celebrates it.

refined_metal.description: Ten pieces of scrap pressed and pressed again until only the good metal is left.

control_board.description: Three relic circuits soldered to a refined-metal backplate. A mech's nerves.

servo_assembly.description: A servo actuator in a refined-metal housing, strong enough to swing a walker's knee.

mech_frame.description: The walker's spine and hips: refined girders around a control board.

mech_leg.description: One of a walker's two legs, swung by a servo assembly in the knee.

power_core.description: A canister reactor packed with vent gas and run by a control board. It hums when you hold it.

cockpit_shell.description: A sealed, coolant-jacketed pod for two pilots.

cockpit_interior.description: Two seats, a console and a trophy for luck. Fitted out in the hab.

weapon_mount.description: A relic pistol scaled up into a walker's cannon, fed with gas cartridges.

armor_plate.description: A thick alloy plate for a walker's hull. Each one makes it tougher.

crate_stack.description: Somewhere to put things. Mostly other crates.

work_lamp.description: A bright lamp on a stand. Good light makes good work.

tool_wall.description: Every tool on its hook. Engineering at the hab workbench goes faster while one hangs in the hab.

coolant_rack.description: Chilled racks for the bio-bench. Splicing in the hab sometimes saves its ichor and coolant.

grow_bed.description: A planter for seeds from the Quiet Reach. Water it with ichor or coolant and it grows Xenobiology plants.

potted_glowroot.description: A glowroot in a pot. It hums a little at night.

bunk.description: A bunk with a real mattress. Pilots sleep in shifts.

moss_rug.description: Woven seep moss. Soft, and only slightly damp.

hab_banner.description: Your crew's colours, painted in ichor.

specimen_case.description: A glowing case for a specimen from the Quiet Reach. Visitors stare.

glowroot_seed.description: A seed that's glowing already, a bit too keen. Plant it in a hab grow bed and water it with ichor or coolant.

ventbloom_seed.description: It smells of vent gas, even as a seed. Plant it in a hab grow bed and water it with ichor or coolant.

rustcap_spores.description: A pinch of rust-red dust that is very much alive. Plant it in a hab grow bed and water it with ichor or coolant.
